name: Amaranth
siboNotes: Amaranth is well-tolerated on SIBO diets as it's naturally FODMAP-free and easier to digest than many other grains.
preparationTips: Rinse amaranth thoroughly before cooking to remove any bitter saponins
Toast dry amaranth in a pan for 2-3 minutes before adding liquid for nuttier flavor
Cook with 2.5-3 parts water to 1 part amaranth for fluffy texture
Can be popped like popcorn for a crunchy snack or cereal topping
nutritionalHighlights: Complete protein containing all essential amino acids
Good source of fiber and B vitamins
